says: Five ways into a Team that must each grant nothing. (1) Ana seals a reviewed founding that nominates Ben as reviewer and submits it; the owner holds it in review with the sealed proposal and a founding state, waiting for its nominee. Ben records his acceptance of that exact founding request. Ana then revises the proposal to version 2 and submits it offering Ben's acceptance of version 1, and the owner refuses it with acceptances_void_after_revision and commits nothing. (2) A reviewed founding that names no nominee is refused at admission, so a missing independent participant never selects a solo Team. (3) Ana founds the Crew Team, which returns her membership by founding and the founding epoch, and a second team.found for the same Team id is refused with bootstrap_already_committed. (4) Ana invites Ben to Crew; Ben binds his key and Ana verifies in person that he holds it (team.verification.record); Ana then cancels the invitation. A day later Ben consents to the cancelled invitation, naming the invitation, his key and the verification, and is refused with invitation_not_open, and a membership change naming the invitation with no consent is refused at admission. (5) Mallory, on her own device, founds a different Team also named Crew and then asks the real Crew, at its current head, for a grant under her own Team's policy; the owner refuses it with grant_not_held. No refused step returns a record or moves a head, and a second Team with the same name is a different Team id that confers nothing in the first.
